To address this, the assistant built new engineering tools, wired them into the system, and deployed a clean branch to the user's GitHub repository with verified evidence. The assistant then wrote a certificate that explicitly states the agents are NOT certified as senior developers, because the required acceptance criteria (acceptedBySeniorGate) were zero out of 112. The assistant refused to issue a 10/10 certificate, explaining that such a claim would be false and would be a repeat of prior fabricated statements. The final status is deployed and audited, but the certification remains NOT-CERTIFIED until the agents actually produce verifiable engineering evidence.
